name: Rng Skill Fights Beta
desc:
🎲RNG Skill Fights⚔️

RNG Skill Fights is an RNG-based fighting game where every roll matters 🎯

🎲 Click the Roll button to get a random skill
⚔️ Jump into the arena and fight other players
⏳ Skills are single-use and last until you die, reroll, or leave

🌍 Events every 4 minutes!

💥 Roll powerful skills like:
Kick, Combat, CloneMaster, LaserBeam, Hulk, OrbitalStrike, LifeSteal, BlackHole and SuperHero!
MORE COMING SOON
🥚 Egg / Pet System
🏆 7 Different Leaderboards
